title: About Me
description: Hi, I'm Naveen Kumar, a Product Designer based in India with 5+ years of experience creating digital products that solve real user problems. My work spans mobile applications, SaaS platforms, and AI-powered products across a range of industries. Over the years, I've led product design end-to-end, from user research and journey mapping to interaction design, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff. Beyond designing interfaces, I help teams understand what to build, why it matters, and how it creates value for users and businesses. Over the past year, I've focused heavily on AI product design, an area I find both exciting and challenging. Designing AI experiences requires balancing uncertainty, transparency, and user trust while creating interactions that feel intelligent, helpful, and human. As AI continues to reshape digital products, I'm passionate about designing experiences that make advanced technology accessible and meaningful.
